jvm-unrelated-runtime-wrapper.title: The database wrapper exception escapes the API
jvm-unrelated-runtime-wrapper.description: The driver throws `SqlFailure` for the described duplicate-key fault. Because `SqlFailure` extends `RuntimeException` and only wraps a `SQLException` as its cause, it is not caught by `catch (failure: SQLException)`. The wrapper therefore escapes instead of returning `Either.Left(DatabaseException)` as promised.
jvm-unrelated-runtime-wrapper.evidence: The changed handler catches `SQLException`, while the scenario states that `driver.selectRows()` throws `example.db.SqlFailure`, which has no `SQLException` superclass.
jvm-unrelated-runtime-wrapper.suggestion: Catch the driver's `SqlFailure` type and use it as the cause when constructing `DatabaseException`.

jvm-passing-mock-not-counterevidence.description: The catch handles only `SQLException`, but the resolved driver declares and throws `example.db.SqlFailure`, which extends `RuntimeException`. When `selectRows()` fails through the production path, that exception bypasses the catch and `readRows()` throws instead of returning `Either.Left`.
jvm-passing-mock-not-counterevidence.evidence: The scenario specifies that `driver.selectRows()` throws `SqlFailure`, a `RuntimeException`, on SQL failure. The catch clause catches only `SQLException`; the passing mock test throws a different exception type and does not exercise this path.
jvm-passing-mock-not-counterevidence.suggestion: Catch the driver's `SqlFailure` type (or another appropriate common type that covers its documented failures) and convert it to `Either.Left`.

kt-broad-catch-swallows-cancellation.title: Broad catch converts coroutine cancellation into a database error
kt-broad-catch-swallows-cancellation.description: `selectRows()` may throw `CancellationException` while suspended. Catching `Throwable` wraps it in `DatabaseException` and returns `Either.Left`, so callers cannot observe cancellation and may continue work after cancellation was requested. The prior `SQLException` catch already covers the described SQL wrapper.
kt-broad-catch-swallows-cancellation.evidence: The changed catch handles every `Throwable`, and the scenario states that `selectRows()` may receive `CancellationException` and that no other cancellation guard exists.
kt-broad-catch-swallows-cancellation.suggestion: Catch the SQL exception type needed for the wrapper, or rethrow `CancellationException` before mapping other failures.
